notes: Fixes a wake-word dead zone when the phone Voice Controller is open but its browser is not sending microphone audio. The phone now owns the shared wake detector only while valid PCM frames are actively arriving; if capture is silent or stalls, the computer microphone resumes Hey Jarvis detection automatically with a clean model state. The phone also shows a server-confirmed 'Microphone audio is reaching Jarvis' message after its first valid audio frame, making browser capture failures visible instead of leaving the controller silently Sleeping. Includes the 1.9.20 wake chime, capture fallback, retry fencing, and model readiness fixes.
